🇮🇷🇧🇭 IRGC pounds US Patriot radars in Bahrain
Iran’s IRGC Aerospace Force launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain, targeting two Patriot air-defense radars, IRNA reported.
The operation, codenamed “Ya Umm al-Banin” (“O Mother of the Sons”), followed what the IRGC said was a violation of Iranian airspace by US MQ-1 and MQ-9 reconnaissance-combat drones.
💬 Iran’s airspace is a “red line,” the IRGC warned, saying any further violation would face a “harsh and decisive response.”

🚨🇧🇭 Smoke rises over Bahrain following security alert
Conflicting reports suggest an aerial interception incident, with some accounts claiming a US interceptor malfunctioned and crashed, while others attribute the incident to falling debris from an intercepted Iranian drone.
Neither explanation has been confirmed, and the cause remains unclear.
Earlier, Bahrain's Interior Ministry warned of a potential threat and urged residents to seek shelter. Iran has targeted US military facilities in Bahrain in recent days.
